imperfect_tense.overview: El Pretérito Imperfecto expresa acciones pasadas que ocurrían de manera habitual o continua. Se usa para describir contexto, acciones repetidas, y estados en el pasado. Es fundamental para la narración en español.

only_3_irregular_verbs.note: Only SER, IR, and VER are irregular in imperfect

uses.name: Habitual or Repeated Actions in the Past
uses.description: Actions that happened regularly or repeatedly over a period of time in the past

examples.spanish: Antes yo pasaba surfeando en la playa.
examples.english: Before, I used to spend my time surfing at the beach.
examples.explanation: Habitual action in the past; suggests regular repetition

examples.spanish: Muchas veces pasé unas bonitas vacaciones.
examples.english: Many times I spent nice vacations.
examples.explanation: Repeated past action; frequency indicates imperfect usage

examples.spanish: De niño, jugaba al fútbol todos los días.
examples.english: As a child, I played soccer every day.

uses.name: Background or Descriptive Context
uses.description: Setting the scene or describing conditions that were true in the past; provides the background for actions

examples.spanish: El barco era blanco, tenía 9 pasajeros, una bandera azul y navegaba lentamente.
examples.english: The boat was white, had 9 passengers, a blue flag, and was sailing slowly.
examples.explanation: Describing the state and characteristics of the boat; background context

examples.spanish: Hacía mucho calor, había poca gente en la playa.
examples.english: It was very hot, there were few people at the beach.

examples.spanish: Era verano, el cielo estaba azul, los pájaros cantaban.
examples.english: It was summer, the sky was blue, birds were singing.

uses.name: Mental, Emotional, or Physical States in the Past
uses.description: Feelings, emotions, thoughts, and physical conditions that existed at a point in time

examples.spanish: Estaba feliz, aunque un poco nervioso.
examples.english: I was happy, although a bit nervous.

examples.spanish: Pensaba que era una buena idea.
examples.english: I thought it was a good idea.

uses.name: Age, Time, and Circumstances
uses.description: Expressing what time it was, how old someone was, or the circumstances

examples.spanish: Tenía 15 años cuando aprendí a conducir.
examples.english: I was 15 years old when I learned to drive.
examples.explanation: Age at a specific point in the past

examples.spanish: Era las tres de la tarde cuando llegó.
examples.english: It was 3 o'clock in the afternoon when he arrived.

uses.name: Continuous or Progressive Actions in the Past
uses.description: An action that was ongoing at a specific moment; what was happening

examples.explanation: Ongoing action in the past at a certain moment

examples.english: When you called, I was eating.

uses.name: Polite Requests or Suggestions
uses.description: Using imperfect for polite, indirect requests

examples.english: I wanted to ask you for a favor.
Did you want to come with me?

uses.name: Habitual Condition or General Truth in the Past
uses.spanish_name: Condición habitual o verdad general en el pasado
uses.description: Things that were generally true or typical during a period

examples.spanish: Los niños siempre jugaban en el parque después de la escuela.
examples.english: The children always played in the park after school.
examples.explanation: Habitual condition; general truth during that time

examples.spanish: En esa época, la gente no tenía internet.
examples.english: In that era, people didn't have the internet.
examples.explanation: General truth of that historical period

uses.name: Contrast with Preterite (Specific Completed Actions)
uses.description: Imperfect provides background while preterite marks specific events

examples.spanish: Ayer pasé un bonito día en la playa. Antes yo pasaba surfeando en la playa.
examples.english: Yesterday I spent a nice day at the beach. Before, I used to spend time surfing at the beach.
examples.explanation: Preterite (pasé) = specific past event; Imperfect (pasaba) = habitual past action

examples.spanish: Vimos que el barco chocó, se destruyó y luego se hundió. El barco era blanco, tenía 9 pasajeros...
examples.english: We saw that the boat collided, was destroyed, and then sank. The boat was white, had 9 passengers...
examples.explanation: Preterite (chocó, se destruyó, se hundió) = sequence of completed events; Imperfect (era, tenía) = background description

preterite_vs_imperfect.rule: PRETERITE = Completed action; a single event that finished. IMPERFECT = Background, habitual, or ongoing state in the past.

comparison_chart.preterite: Marked as completed; has a clear endpoint
comparison_chart.imperfect: No clear endpoint; was ongoing or habitual

comparison_chart.preterite: Specific moment or series of moments

example_pair.preterite_english: It began to rain. (Specific moment when rain started)
example_pair.imperfect_english: It was raining. (Rain was ongoing; no specified start/stop)
example_pair.together: Comienzó a llover mientras yo caminaba por el parque.
example_pair.together_english: It began to rain while I was walking through the park. (Preterite: specific moment rain started; Imperfect: my walking was ongoing)

common_imperfect_time_markers: de vez en cuando (from time to time)
cuando (when - used with imperfect for concurrent actions)

practice_sentences.spanish: Cuando era niño, vivía en Madrid.
practice_sentences.english: When I was a child, I lived in Madrid.

practice_sentences.spanish: Todos los días me levantaba a las 7 y desayunaba cereal.
practice_sentences.english: Every day I got up at 7 and ate cereal for breakfast.

practice_sentences.spanish: Hacía sol y hacía calor. No había nubes en el cielo.
practice_sentences.english: It was sunny and hot. There were no clouds in the sky.

practice_sentences.spanish: Me sentía mal, pero tenía que ir al trabajo.
practice_sentences.english: I was feeling bad, but I had to go to work.

practice_sentences.spanish: Mientras estudiaba, oí un ruido extraño.
practice_sentences.english: While I was studying, I heard a strange noise.
